desc:
Were aware Freebuild is currently glitched and houses do not appear were working on a fix.

Design & Decorate is a decoration game where you compete with others to design the nicest house interior. When the time is up, show your decorating skills and become a winner!

WARNING: If you've got an issue with the build UI, please leave and rejoin as it'll fix itself. The game is very new so feel free to give us suggestions in the forums and we will read & respond to it.

🛋️ Decorate to the themes
🔨 Show off your designer skills
⏰ Compete with others with a time limit
🏡 Buy new houses as you progress

Join our community for in-game rewards!
